name: Trackers and Logs Index
body:
> Index · 2026-10-22

Cross-client trackers, task lists, logs and multi-client reports.

# Live trackers
- [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker): manual Request Indexing runs and queue for all four properties (last run Oct 13 2026).
- [Search Terms Check Log](lib:brain-search-terms-check-log): per-campaign Google Ads search-term review checkpoints (early July 2026).
- [Blog Master List](lib:brain-blog-master-list): July and August 2026 blog clusters for all four clients (Jul 21 2026).

# Task lists
- [Today Pending 2026-10-13](lib:brain-today-pending-2026-10-13): daily plan from Keystone and the Oct 8 EOD.
- [Monday Task Lists 2026-06-05](lib:brain-monday-task-lists-2026-06-05): done and pending task exports for monday.com (three CSVs merged).

# Multi-client reports
- [Broken Link Report 2026-05-29](lib:brain-broken-link-report-2026-05-29): crawl of Summit, Alphalete and Pipeliners (7, 8 and 85 broken links).
- [Dead Link Locations 2026-05-29](lib:brain-dead-link-locations-2026-05-29): where each dead link sits on the page, for manual fixes.
- [Local Page Optimization Report 2026-05-30](lib:brain-local-page-optimization-report-2026-05-30): SEO/GEO/AEO status of location pages per client.
- [Optimization Report 2026-05-30](lib:brain-optimization-report-2026-05-30): short Kim-format version plus Google Ads review.
